text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired for RWI-20260314-01 (high error rate, region routing anomalies) :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Incident triggered by service=route-proxy, region=us-west-2, zone=az3, severity=critical. Pager: @oncall_zephyr. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/RWI-20260314-01
oncall_zephyr: acknowledged. I'm on it. Starting triage — pulling metrics and checking autoscaler.
sre_maya: adding context — saw a small spike ~3172467000 then control-plane started returning 503s for internal healthcheck. Could be routing table convergence.
oncall_zephyr: quick checks:
```
# check control plane pods
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=control-plane -o wide
# check route-proxy logs for az3
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/route-proxy --since=10m | grep az3 | tail -n 100
```
eng-runtime-ryan: I see repeated "KVCache miss: shard unassigned" in az3 route-proxy logs around 3172466900. Also noticed spike in evictions on the local shard manager.
ops-dina: autoscaler logs show a failed scale-up in az3 due to GCE quota error at 3172467052: `insufficient_quota: GPUs` — that could explain capacity imbalance.
pm-claire: customer-impact note from monitoring: 502/503 rate spiked to 9.8% for text-gen endpoints in us-west-2/az3; p50 latency double for some tenants. Marking as potential degraded service.
cs-john: flagged 3 paying customers via Slack and email; they're seeing timeouts on embeddings and chat. Support ticket ids: SUP-5432, SUP-5433, SUP-5434.
oncall_zephyr: plan: 1) attempt traffic diversion away from az3 to warm pool in us-west-2; 2) if diversion fails, activate cross-region failover to us-west-1; 3) continue investigating quota root cause.
sre_maya: agree. Prep commands to move traffic, will coordinate with eng-runtime.
eng-runtime-ryan: I'm going to try a targeted routing policy swap for the affected shard group. Command (dry-run first):
```
# dry-run
./routectl --env prod --region us-west-2 --from az3 --to warm-pool-2 --dry-run
# apply
./routectl --env prod --region us-west-2 --from az3 --to warm-pool-2 --apply
```
oncall_zephyr: run dry-run and paste output.
eng-runtime-ryan: dry-run output: "plan: shift 12% of traffic off az3 shards to warm-pool-2; no dependency conflicts detected"
eng-runtime-ryan: applying now.
ops-dina: we're seeing immediate drop in 5xx rate in az3 proxies (from 9.8% -> 3.2% over 45s). Good sign.
pm-claire: CS update: two customers report partial recovery, one still seeing errors. Notified them we're diverting traffic.
cs-john: updating tickets with mitigation steps and ETA.
oncall_zephyr: quick telemetry snapshot:
- route-proxy 5xx us-west-2/az3: 9.8% -> 1.4% after diversion
- request rate (embedding): 120rps -> 115rps (slightly reduced)
- control-plane error rate: 7% -> 2%
eng-runtime-ryan: follow-up: the autoscaler quota error prevented expected scale-up; while we diverted traffic, we should remediate quota before restoring normal routing. Filed cloud-ticket CT-9981 for quota increase request.
sre_maya: I'll keep watch on KV cache reassignments; if we see rebalancing flaps, we'll throttle reassign to avoid burst evictions.
oncall_zephyr: escalation check: still within our mitigation window, no PD escalation required. @pm-claire please prepare customer comms draft for affected tenants.
pm-claire: drafting now — will post to this thread in 10m.
cs-john: note — enterprise customer AcmeCorp requests an incident bridge, they want continuous updates. Recommend bridge now.
oncall_zephyr: setting up bridge. Bridge link: https://meet.example/incident-RWI-20260314-01
ops-dina: after traffic shift, we see minor CPU pressure on warm-pool-2 but within thresholds. Autoscaler remains blocked for az3 due to quota.
eng-runtime-ryan: next steps: 1) keep diversion in place; 2) unblock quota or provision temporary warm capacity in another zone; 3) once stable for 15m, start gradual shift back. Who's taking handoff at 02:00 UTC?
sre_maya: I can take the 02:00 UTC handoff; will monitor reassign and control-plane logs.
oncall_zephyr: handing off to @sre_maya for ongoing mitigation and post-incident follow-up at 02:00 UTC. Leaving notes in runbook: "diverted traffic -> warm-pool-2; cloud ticket CT-9981; check for shard flapping; CS updated; bridge established."
cs-john: bridge participants: AcmeCorp, Support, SRE, Runtime. I'll keep tickets updated and post a short customer status now.
pm-claire: posted status to customers: "We've diverted traffic away from the affected zone and are actively provisioning capacity; partial service restored — detailed update on completion ETA in 30m."
oncall_zephyr: marking on-call ack cleared. If anything degrades further, PD will re-escalate.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident status changed to mitigated (action=traffic_diversion) — monitoring for stability.
sre_maya: monitoring for 15m window. If stable, we'll schedule rollback to original routing and ensure autoscaler quota fixed first.
eng-runtime-ryan: action item: follow up with cloud infra to confirm CT-9981 priority and temporary provisioning options.
cs-john: I'll close the three support tickets when we confirm full restoration.
ops-dina: adding log snippet showing initial quota rejection:
```
2026-03-14T01:24:12Z ERROR scaler: provision failed: insufficient_quota: GPUs
request-id=abc123 region=us-west-2 zone=az3
```
pm-claire: adding postmortem owner: @sre_maya. Please include timeline, root cause (quota + routing imbalance), mitigation, and follow-ups (quota request, improve autoscaler error handling).
sre_maya: acknowledged. I'll own postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident will remain open until rollback and quota remediation confirmed. If resolved, please update this thread with final resolution and close time.
eng-runtime-ryan: noted. Leaving a short checklist in thread: [diverted, CT-9981 filed, bridge, CS updated, handoff to SRE].
pm-claire: thanks all. Keeping channel muted except for critical updates. :white_check_mark:
